value.rationale: The exact affine dimension and Fourier identifiability of the natural independent-dominating-set ensemble on squared cycles is a nontrivial complete classification: length 11 loses a deterministic mode after full-rank lengths 9 and 10, and all n>=12 regain full rank. It gives a precise applicability boundary for first-coordinate harmonic reconstruction, not an arbitrary finite statistic.
